basics.name: Adi Alfian Hafis
basics.label: Full-Stack Software Engineer
basics.summary: Results-driven Full-Stack Software Engineer and Computer Science graduate (GPA 3.97/4.00) with proven experience building high-reliability web applications, operational ERPs, and distributed services. Architected institutional financial systems processing bank Virtual Account webhooks with 100% automated ledger reconciliation, and engineered client-side AI biometrics with sub-400ms execution. Proficient in TypeScript, React, Next.js, Laravel, and PostgreSQL.

work.name: MAN 1 Kota Semarang
work.summary: Architected and deployed SIMMAN E-Budgeting, an institutional financial ERP managing tuition collections and departmental budgets across thousands of students.
highlights: Integrated direct Host-to-Host (H2H) banking webhook pipelines, automating 100% of student Virtual Account (VA) payment reconciliation directly into the general ledger without manual intervention.
Engineered automated RKA budgeting engine that programmatically enforced hard-locks on departmental spending ceilings, eliminating operational over-expenditures.
Developed automated bank reconciliation pipeline balancing internal ledger records against daily bank mutation statements, accelerating month-end audit closings from days to instant queries.
Automated multi-tier PDF and Excel financial audit reports with programmatic validation and hierarchical digital approval workflows.

work.name: Acrylico Industrial Fabrication
work.summary: Engineered custom Acrylico ERP to digitize manufacturing workflows, replacing legacy paper job-tickets with real-time operational boards.
highlights: Implemented edge facial recognition clock-in utilizing @vladmandic/face-api (128-d tensor embeddings), verifying worker attendance in under 400ms entirely client-side without streaming sensitive biometrics to external clouds.
Built interactive shop floor Kanban ticket boards providing real-time production telemetry across cutting, bending, engraving, and QC workstations.
Architected progressive billing engine synchronizing quotations, purchase orders, material costs, and down-payment status transitions.
Authored automated end-to-end test suites using Playwright, validating authentication, attendance biometrics, and invoice states on every release.

work.name: CV Nastiti Utama Mandiri (Timnas Production)
work.summary: Co-developed Timnas Production ERP, a centralized operations management platform for regional event campaigns and field personnel.
highlights: Designed dynamic profit margin calculation engine supporting dual management fee formulas (deduction and markup), accelerating financial report generation from weeks to real-time.
Implemented geospatial Leaflet GPS mapping for live field team dispatching, site location tracking, and attendance verification across Central Java.
Built structured before/after photo inspection pipeline with client-side image compression, reducing upload bandwidth while ensuring tamper-resistant site logs.
Configured granular role-based access control (RBAC) using Spatie Laravel Permission, isolating Super Admin, Finance, PM, and Field Staff consoles.

work.name: Nata Code Digital Agency
work.summary: Founded and engineered Nata Code, an independent software house platform delivering modern web experiences and bespoke client solutions.
highlights: Architected hybrid SPA application using React 18, Inertia.js 2.0, and Laravel 13, eliminating full-page reload latencies and reducing route transition delays to zero.
Developed dynamic hardware tier profiling engine (useDeviceTier) assessing device RAM and concurrency to scale animation budgets, sustaining locked 60fps motion across mobile devices.
Engineered modular SaaS service catalog and case-study CMS with instant live search and dark/light mode persistence.
